definitions.gloss: visit to someone who is sick or in trouble
definitions.explanation: The act of visiting someone to express sympathy or concern.
A gift brought when visiting someone who is ill or has experienced misfortune.

examples.japanese: {病院|びょういん}にお{見舞|みま}いに{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to visit someone at the hospital.
examples.notes: お{見舞|みま}い is the polite form

examples.japanese: {見舞|みま}いの{品|しな}を{持|も}って{行|い}った。
{災害|さいがい}{見舞|みま}いの{手紙|てがみ}を{送|おく}った。
examples.english: I sent a letter of sympathy for the disaster.

notes:
Usually used with the polite prefix お as お{見舞|みま}い.

TYPES OF {見舞|みま}い:
・{病気|びょうき}{見舞|みま}い (visiting the sick)
・{災害|さいがい}{見舞|みま}い (disaster condolences)
・{暑中|しょちゅう}{見舞|みま}い (summer greeting card)
・{残暑|ざんしょ}{見舞|みま}い (late summer greeting card)
・{寒中|かんちゅう}{見舞|みま}い (winter greeting card)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・お{見舞|みま}いに{行|い}く (to go visit someone)
・お{見舞|みま}いを{申|もう}し{上|あ}げる (formal expression of sympathy)
・{見舞金|みまいきん} (monetary gift for illness/disaster)
